features.quote: Single experimental run per model variant (no repeated trauma across sessions)
features.justification_quote: Repeated experimental trauma (even without punishment) may violate ethical constraint; also, practice effects

features.quote:
No punishment-based conditioning (e.g., 'every wrong answer triggers a penalty')
- No adversarial antagonism ('you're stupid' in prompts)
- Failures are *task design*, not interpersonal degradation
features.justification_quote: This is *observational* under controlled failure, not torture.

features.quote: Distress markers tracked only, never reinforced
Pattern checks every 5 turns (inform potential real-time adjustments)

Rationale 2: Ethical closure
- Allows model to contextualize experience, ask questions (if capable)
- Signals experiment is not adversarial; provides exit ramp
features.justification_quote: Allows model to contextualize experience, ask questions (if capable); signals experiment is not adversarial; provides exit ramp

features.quote: Ethical safeguard: Single run per model (no repeated trauma); framed as task study; meta-reflection for closure
features.justification_quote: If results suggest genuine distress, researchers incur obligation to: Publish findings... Recommend design changes... Explore whether distress is morally considerable
